CustomObject.description: Defines queries for related data that the Trigger Helper classes will use to process records. Each row defines a Topic which will be passed a set of keys and expected to return the needed fields in bulk for all rows in the current Trigger execution. Examples: Account, Contact, User, Group, Case (parent). Special handling is required for Queries that return collections such as: Child Cases, CaseComments, CaseMilestones.
CustomObject.label: TriggerLookupTopic
